# openvicloud_volume (Resource)

A block volume of the tenant; attach it to a VM with openvicloud_volume_attachment. Any change replaces the volume.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `size_gb` (Number)
- `volume_offering_id` (String) Kind of volume (data source openvicloud_volume_offerings).
- `zone_id` (String) Zone of the volume; the same as the VM it attaches to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
